get.description: Liveness — the process is up (no dependency checks). Always 200.
Readiness — dependencies reachable. 503 when not ready (for load-balancer probes).

Anonymous SSE subscription to this tournament's own channel — never the org
channel. Re-validates visibility the same way every other public read does; no
principal, no `is_authorized` (that's the authenticated-only gate).

ActivityEventView.title: ActivityEventView
ActivityEventView.description:
One row of the org-wide audit trail (`AuditLog`), scoped to a single tournament —
the source for the Match Center's activity timeline.

MatchResultEventView.title: MatchResultEventView
MatchResultEventView.description:
One row of the append-only scoring/correction log for a match (`MatchResultEvent`) —
the source of truth for Match Detail's history panel.

SwapMembersRequest.title: SwapMembersRequest
SwapMembersRequest.description: Swap two members between their (different) proposed teams — a manual override.

UpdateCourtRequest.title: UpdateCourtRequest
UpdateCourtRequest.description: Partial update — omitted fields are left unchanged.

UploadTarget.title: UploadTarget
UploadTarget.description: Where and how the client uploads the bytes directly (presigned).
